combined_finding: Current CMS exact-CCN data binds CCN 140228 to Rockford; Illinois's 2026 planning inventory (based on 2024 state survey) lists Belvidere separately under the SwedishAmerican operator, while the state report-card API marks the older Belvidere entity closed 2023-04-20 with no MPN and UW's current page separately lists Belvidere Hospital. These are compatible with a renamed/successor state facility, but no source here links Belvidere to CCN 140228 or explains why the 2026-04-01 MRF metadata includes Belvidere Hospital.
